auc_definition: For each resource, use the Card deficit reference R_i(1.5) for scale, R_i(16) for rank, and R_i(1) for density. Map the tested minimum and maximum linearly to x=[0,1]; calculate signed trapezoidal integral with no further interval-width division. Preserve signed values.
density_oracle_status: enabled; task-wide global top-K convention frozen
external_input_identity: Future registration binds base model files, adapter weights and configs, heads, dataset/split files, both split reference files, critical source code, and frozen design/manifest/preregistration hashes.
grouped_evaluation: Phase A leave-one-task-out; validation only for fitting/tuning. Final-test held task/context fitted from validation rows excluding the held group. No final-test label used for fitting, feature/oracle selection, or tuning.
phase_c_status: 9 exact unique six-task memberships and 22 focal rows registered from Experiment 3 context-selection archive; no old responses reused.
server_status: protocol frozen; asset/input-identity preflight required before real validation/final-test evaluation
auc_rationale: A unit normalized tested axis makes resource ranges comparable while retaining signed area; another interval-width divisor computes an average instead of the requested integral.
density_operational_rule: For focal-task baseline post-projection/top-k support N, retain K=round-half-up(d*N) globally across modules by descending absolute value; deterministic ties use stable module name then flattened coordinate index. d=1 exactly reproduces baseline support. Record requested density, target, actual, and per-module counts.
composite_estimator_gate: The Card requires a reasonable single-feature signal before using a composite but defines no threshold. Preregistered operationalization: allow composite only if at least one individual feature has a validation whole-context-bootstrap Spearman 95% interval excluding zero. The gate uses validation labels only; final-test labels never select features, thresholds, or estimators.
